'''Priate''' was the primary [[star]] of the [[Mustafar system]] in [[Outer Rim Territories]]' [[Atravis sector]]. The [[star system]] was located along the [[Tosste Spur]] trade route, 53,000 [[light-year]]s away from the [[Core Worlds|Core]] in [[Standard Galactic Grid]] L-19. It was originally orbited by the [[gas giant]]s [[Jestefad]] and [[Lefrani]] and the [[planet]] [[Mustafar]]; however,<ref name="BMF17" /> after the energies from the artifact known as the [[Bright Star]] altered Lefrani's orbit,<ref name="VaderImmortal">{{VaderImmortal|I}}</ref> Mustafar became suspended in an erratic path between the immense [[Gravity|gravitational]] fields of the [[Star system|system's]] two gas giants, causing the planet's [[Devastation of Mustafar|devastation]].<ref name="BMF17" /> Later, in [[19 BBY]],<ref name="SWGA">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> fallen [[Jedi Knight]]-turned-[[Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] looked up at Priate as it became eclipsed by Lefrani.<ref name="Episode III">{{Film|III}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Priate first appeared in the [[2005]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']].<ref name="Episode III" /> In the new ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], it was identified in the [[2015]] magazine [[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon 17|''Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon'' 17]].<ref name="BMF17" />
